chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:
"Whoever comes to the grave of al-Ḥusayn عليه السلام recognizing his right, Allah, the Mighty and Exalted, will record him in the highest of ʿIlliyyīn."

key_terms.الْحُسَيْنِ: al-Ḥusayn عليه السلام, the grandson of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.بِحَقِّهِ: of his right, meaning his true due, rank, and authority
key_terms.عَارِفًا: knowing or recognizing with awareness and understanding
key_terms.عِلِّيِّينَ: ʿIlliyyīn, the highest register or rank of the righteous
key_terms.قَبْرَ: the grave, referring here to the burial place visited in ziyārah
key_terms.كَتَبَهُ: He recorded him or inscribed him

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for visiting the grave of Imam al-Ḥusayn عليه السلام while recognizing his right?
ai.summary: This hadith states the great reward for visiting the grave of al-Ḥusayn عليه السلام with true recognition of his divinely appointed right and status. It presents such ziyārah as a spiritually elevated act whose reward is being written among the highest ranks of the righteous in ʿIlliyyīn.
